notes:
Mid-market billing SaaS. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API for chat/agent workflows (support agents handling Stripe/Zuora flows) with plan to move to Dedicated if POC meets SLOs. Key ask: streaming + tool-calling reliability; structured JSON outputs so agent actions can be ingested into their ticketing system.

Summary: - Primary workload: customer support billing assistant (refunds, invoice lookup, plan changes). - Integration targets: Stripe customer/charge/invoice APIs, Zuora billing runs. - Latency SLO: sub-500ms first byte for simple lookups; streaming for long responses must start streaming within 250-350ms and sustain steady chunks. - Throughput: peaks at month-end (~150 concurrent agents), baseline 20-40 concurrent. - Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget but willing to subscribe to Dedicated for predictable end-of-month throughput.

Security/Compliance: "can't expose raw billing data off our VPC" — require VPC/private deployment options for Dedicated; SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for staff, audit logs, KMS for key management. Data residency: US-only for payment data.

POC plan (proposed): 2-week POC using Hosted API: 1) Implement tool-calling layer for 6 common flows (refund, invoice lookup, prorate, plan change, subscription cancel, payment method update). 2) Validate structured JSON output schema for ticket ingestion. 3) Run load tests to mimic month-end concurrency and validate streaming latencies. 4) Security questionnaire + short network review. Success criteria: streaming start within 350ms for 95% of requests at baseline load; tool-calls succeed end-to-end with idempotency; JSON output adheres to agreed schema.

Quotes / call notes: - AE: "want to see streaming and tool calling in real traffic, then decide on Dedicated". - Head of Product: "If we can't guarantee month-end SLA, we can't move forward — predictability is non-negotiable". - Security: "Need SOC2 report and KMS integration; prefer VPC for any production token exchange."

Commercial: Demo 2026-01-20; pricing proposal sent 2026-02-19 (baseline Dedicated seat + peak burst add-on). ARR band "75k-250k" discussed; procurement process expected by 2026-05 if POC successful.

Notes are shorthand; follow-ups: POC kickoff 2026-02-25 (Diego to run technical scoping), security Q sent 2026-02-05, Redwood to provide streaming perf ran and example tool-calling flows.
